lessons.title: What is an example service?
lessons.summary: A short, beginner-friendly lesson used to document the lesson format.
learningObjectives: Explain what an example service is
lessons.explanation:
An **example service** is a fictional service used in documentation.

- It is managed for you.
- You pay only for what you use.

terminology.definition: A service where the provider operates the underlying infrastructure.

lessons.businessScenario: Contoso Bakery wants to launch an online order form without buying servers.
lessons.technicalExample: The bakery deploys a web app to a managed platform and scales it during holidays.

misconception.myth: Managed services give you no control.
misconception.reality: You still control configuration, data and access; the provider runs the infrastructure.

lessons.examTakeaway: When a scenario says *minimize infrastructure management*, prefer a managed (PaaS or SaaS) option.
lessons.recap: Managed services reduce operational work while you keep control of your data and configuration.
lessons.simplerExplanation: Think of a managed service like renting a furnished flat: someone else fixes the boiler.
lessons.anotherExample: A school uses a hosted email service instead of running its own mail servers.

items.prompt: Who patches the OS of a managed platform?

data.title: Exam tip
data.body: Look for keywords such as *minimize management effort*.

flashcards.back: The provider operates the underlying infrastructure.
You pay for what you use.

knowledgeCheck.stem: Contoso wants to minimize the time spent patching servers. Which approach best meets this goal?
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A managed platform shifts OS patching to the provider.

options.explanation: The provider patches the platform, reducing operational work.

options.text: Run virtual machines and patch them manually
options.explanation: You remain responsible for patching the guest OS.

tr.stem: Contoso, sunuculara yama uygulamak için harcanan zamanı en aza indirmek istiyor. Bu hedefi en iyi hangi yaklaşım karşılar?
tr.explanation: Yönetilen bir platform, işletim sistemi yamalarını sağlayıcıya devreder.

A.explanation: Platforma sağlayıcı yama uygular ve operasyonel iş azalır.

B.text: Ek şirket içi sunucular satın almak
B.explanation: Daha fazla sunucu daha fazla yama işi demektir.

C.text: Sanal makineler çalıştırıp elle yama uygulamak
C.explanation: Konuk işletim sisteminin yamalanmasından siz sorumlu kalırsınız.

knowledgeCheck.stem: Which **two** are benefits of consumption-based pricing?
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Consumption-based pricing avoids upfront costs and lets you pay only for what you use.

options.explanation: You do not buy hardware in advance.

options.text: Pay only for resources you use

options.explanation: Monitoring is still important to avoid surprises.

knowledgeCheck.stem: With a managed service, the customer is still responsible for managing access to their own data.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Customers always remain responsible for their data and access management.

options.explanation: Data and access remain the customer's responsibility.
The provider never takes over responsibility for who can access your data.

knowledgeCheck.stem: Match each requirement to the most suitable option.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Each requirement maps to the option that best reduces effort for that need.

prompts.text: Full control of the operating system

explanations.p1: IaaS gives you control of the OS.

knowledgeCheck.stem: Place the steps in the correct order to publish the order form.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: You create the container first, then deploy, then test.

explanations.s1: A resource must exist before deployment.
explanations.s2: Code is deployed into the resource.
